main_text.p: Quotuplex est forma Verbi? Duplex: Prima aut Secunda.
Quotuplex est Persona? Triplex, & unaquaeq; suo genere distinguitur: prima tamen quaelibet, & tertia pluralis praeteriti sunt communes.
Quotuplex est tempus? Duplex: Praeteritum aut Futurum.
Quotuplex est Praeteritum? Vnicum est pro omnibus praeteritis, ut פקד visitabat, visitavit, visitaverat.
Quotuplex est Futurum? Duplex: Primum aut secundum. Cum praeteritum & futurum primum indefinitè sumuntur etiam praesens tempus comprehendunt.
main_text.head: PAAL SIVE CAL. Singularis Numerus.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied as best readable from the scan; the vowel points and the small letters under the paradigm are faint and may be imperfect. The word "unaquaeq;" is copied as printed, with the q; abbreviation. The paradigm "1.C. 2.M. 3.M." is a column header, not a note. The word "Vnicum" and the Hebrew verbs are as printed. Right edge of the page is cut by the scan; the ends of some lines ("distinguitur", "indefini-", "com-") continue beyond the visible edge and are completed from the hyphenated printing where the text makes it certain.
